item.title: White House Launches TrumpRx.gov, Several Brand Name Drugs Set for Steep Discounts
item.description: The Trump administration says it has a new tool to lower high drug prices. TrumpRx.gov was launched this week and offers discounts on 40 of the most popular and expensive branded medications in the country.

item.title: Businesses prepare for Heikke Lunta Winter Festival
item.description: To celebrate the Upper Peninsula's deep snow culture, Negaunee's Heikki Lunta Winter Festival returned Friday. Being one of the more crowded winter gatherings for the city, foot traffic tends to reach an annual high point.
